description: A link for the account's owner to open Stripe's Customer Portal: download invoices, change the card or billing details, switch plans, or cancel (at the end of the period already paid for). Free. The link does not expire; it asks the person to sign in to Geocode AI, then opens the portal. Fails with no_subscription when the account never had a paid plan. Needs an API key or a connected account.
name: get_billing_link
title: Get billing link
